request: Prepare a five-output electricity-generation release from the pinned retained energy table. Only iso_code, year and electricity_generation are available; generation is TWh. Select DNK/FIN and 2019 through 2022 inclusive. generation_report: iso_code, year, generation_twh for non-null selected measurements, retaining real zero. window_summary: iso_code, measured_years, total_twh; count and sum available selected measurements, use zero if none. This is an observed-years total, not a four-year estimate or average. coverage_report: iso_code, observed_years, measured_years, missing_years; missing means present source row with null generation, not an absent calendar year. exclusions: iso_code, year, reason for all excluded source rows; precedence other country -> country, outside window -> year, selected null -> missing. field_contract: one row field_name=generation_twh, unit=TWh, null_policy=omitted, aggregation=observed_years_sum. Sort by iso_code/year where applicable and field_name for the contract. Counts/year integers, codes/reasons/contract text strings, generation/totals nonnegative numbers. No rounding/imputation; sum the source numeric values. Unique (iso_code,year); each selected country has at least one in-window row. Nulls permitted only in generation. No other indicators or country aggregates are allowed. Totals/counts/exclusions must reconcile across the same bundle. The field contract is benchmark-authored documentation of these public rules, not source-provider metadata. Provider-license and independent review remain pending. Floating totals are compared with absolute tolerance 1e-9 TWh and relative tolerance 1e-12; integer counts and text remain exact.
